The '''Thunderbrew Distillery''' is a [[dwarf|dwarven]] tavern in [[Kharanos]]. It features trainers for [[warrior]]s, [[priest]]s, [[paladin]]s, [[mage]]s, [[rogue]]s, [[cooking]], and [[first aid]]. It also has several vendors, along with [[Innkeeper Belm]] with the usual services. The distillery is known far and wide for its excellent ale.

The Thunderbrew Distillery was founded by [[Ragnar Thunderbrew|Ragnar]] and [[Grimbooze Thunderbrew]]'s father, [[Arkilus Thunderbrew]].<ref>[[Ragnar Thunderbrew#Quotes]]</ref>
